seo_title: Cost of Living in Cairo 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Cairo per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: The capital of Egypt and the largest city in the Arab world: a visa on arrival, low prices, history and the pyramids right next door. The downsides — a noisy, chaotic megacity, traffic and air quality.
pros: A visa on arrival, with direct flights from Russia
History and the pyramids right next door
The largest city in the Arab world, with every service imaginable
cons: Heavy traffic and air quality issues
A language barrier outside tourist areas

best_places.name: Pyramids of Giza
best_places.description: The only surviving wonder of the world, on the city's edge.

best_places.name: Zamalek
best_places.description: A green, prestigious island district on the Nile with cafés, embassies and rentals for expats.

best_places.name: Khan el-Khalili

visa_steps.title: Visa on arrival
visa_steps.description: Russians get a visa on arrival (a 30-day tourist visa).

visa_steps.title: Renting a home
visa_steps.description: Flats rent cheaply; Zamalek, Maadi and Heliopolis are popular.

visa_steps.title: Connectivity and money
visa_steps.description: A local SIM card is cheap; you'll need pounds in cash and a foreign bank card.

visa_steps.title: Extension
visa_steps.description: A tourist visa can be extended at the Mogamma or a passport office.

visa_steps.title: Long-term stay
visa_steps.description: For settled living, people consider a residence permit through work, study or property.

faq.question: Do Russians need a visa for Cairo?
faq.answer: A visa is issued on arrival for 30 days, with the option to extend.

faq.question: How much does it cost to live in Cairo?
faq.answer: Very cheap — one of the most budget-friendly megacities. See the calculator above for an exact budget.

faq.question: What language is spoken in Cairo?
faq.answer: Arabic; English is understood in tourism and business, but there can be a barrier in everyday life.

faq.question: Can I pay with a Russian card in Cairo?
faq.answer: No, Russian cards don't work. You'll need pounds in cash and a foreign bank card.

faq.question: What is the climate like in Cairo?
faq.answer: Desert: hot, dry summers and warm, mild winters, with the best season running from autumn to spring.

faq.question: Is Cairo safe?
faq.answer: Tourist and residential areas are generally calm, but a megacity calls for the usual urban caution.

reviews.text: Cairo is cheap and lively, with history at every turn and the pyramids visible from the bus window. The downsides — the chaos, traffic and dust; the rhythm takes some getting used to.
It's a tough city, but it draws you in: delicious food, dirt-cheap prices, hospitality. Zamalek is quiet and green. The air and noise are the main downsides.
